Lines.Speaker: narrator
Lines.Text: Year One ends under the hall's black-and-white banners. Rankings bloom on the wall like a scoreboard that learned to smile.

Lines.Speaker: @head
Lines.Text: Ninety-nine percent. That is not a promise. It is a filter. You have performed exactly as designed.

Lines.Speaker: @homeroom
Lines.Text: Your class points rose whenever you chose the safe move. Predictable. Reliable. Adorable.

Lines.Speaker: @president
Lines.Text: {president} claps once. The sound is polite and absolute. You are already being fitted for a crown that bites.

Lines.Speaker: @rival
Lines.Text: {rival} watches you like a mirror that refuses to fog. 'Congrats. You became the answer key.'

Lines.Speaker: system
Lines.Text: EVALUATION: MODEL STUDENT. Trajectory locked: Puppet at the top.

Lines.Speaker: @ally
Lines.Text: {ally} smiles with something missing behind the teeth. 'We made it. You made it. Same thing, right?'

Text: You won by becoming average on purpose—obedient where it counted, sharp only when the System rewarded it. The school loves that shape of mind.

Choices.Text: Accept the crown. Let the System keep writing you.
Smile for the cameras. Pretend the strings are jewelry.

Lines.Speaker: narrator
Lines.Text: The Year One assembly freezes mid-applause. Someone has edited the script while the actors were still breathing.

Lines.Speaker: system
Lines.Text: WARNING: Prediction miss-rate critical. Student pattern unclassified.

Lines.Speaker: @head
Lines.Text: The evaluation engine was never meant to be outpaced by a first-year. And yet.

Lines.Speaker: @ex1
Lines.Text: {ex1} laughs without joy. 'I used to be number one. You are trying to be the person who writes number one.'

Lines.Speaker: @rival
Lines.Text: {rival} leans in. 'If you seize the board, do not expect me to clap. Expect me to rewrite the clap.'

Lines.Speaker: @gremlin
Lines.Text: {gremlin} stages a tiny coup with a stolen mic. 'Director's notes incoming!' Security does not know where to look.

Lines.Speaker: @homeroom
Lines.Text: Your file has too many footnotes. That is either genius or arson. Possibly both.

Text: You think like an editor with a knife: cut the expected beat, keep the tension, force the school to follow your cut.

Choices.Text: Claim the director's chair. Rewrite next year's exams.
Leave a fake ending in the System logs. Let them chase smoke.

Lines.Speaker: narrator
Lines.Text: Your name is announced. The hall looks for a face and finds a blank seat with perfect attendance on paper.

Lines.Speaker: @homeroom
Lines.Text: Present in data. Absent in memory. That is a talent the rankings do not know how to punish.

Lines.Speaker: system
Lines.Text: PROFILE: LOW SOCIAL FOOTPRINT. Influence vectors: undetected.

Lines.Speaker: @broker
Lines.Text: {broker} whispers to empty air, then to you. 'Ghosts pay well. Ghosts are never billed.'

Lines.Speaker: @ally
Lines.Text: {ally} reaches for your sleeve and catches fabric that already decided to leave. 'I kept defending someone I could not point at.'

Lines.Speaker: @president
Lines.Text: {president} adjusts the mic. 'Congratulations to... the person who made this year happen without starring in it.'

Lines.Speaker: narrator
Lines.Text: Applause arrives late, aimed at the wrong row. You are already half-erased and fully effective.

Text: You win by vanishing—pulling strings from the blind spot, letting credit die lonely while outcomes stay yours.

Choices.Text: Fade further. Become the hallway rumor that rearranges ranks.
File yourself under 'unobserved.' Keep the ledger private.

Lines.Speaker: narrator
Lines.Text: The ranking banners catch fire—metaphorically, then slightly literally, because someone brought paint thinner 'for art.'

Lines.Speaker: @gremlin
Lines.Text: {gremlin} is already mid-chant. The chant has three verses and zero permits.

Lines.Speaker: @ally
Lines.Text: {ally} stands with you, shaking. 'If we burn the ladder, we catch the people still climbing.'

Lines.Speaker: @president
Lines.Text: {president} grips the podium like a life raft. 'Order is kindness at scale. You are calling kindness a cage.'

Lines.Speaker: @rival
Lines.Text: {rival} smiles wrong. 'Abolish ranking? Cute. Survive the vacuum first.'

Lines.Speaker: @head
Lines.Text: Disruption noted. Empathy as weapon is still a weapon. We will... study you.

Lines.Speaker: system
Lines.Text: QUEST FAILED / QUEST REWRITTEN: Ranking integrity compromised.

Text: Your mind pairs mercy with arson. You break the scoreboard because you still care who it was crushing.

Choices.Text: Demand the ranking die before Year Two begins.
Offer amnesty to anyone who drops their rank badge.

Lines.Speaker: narrator
Lines.Text: The hall is too bright. The banners look like teeth. Your hands know the exit better than your grades do.

Lines.Speaker: @nurse
Lines.Text: {nurse} offers water like a truce. 'Your vitals say the school is winning. That is not a compliment.'

Lines.Speaker: @counsellor
Lines.Text: {counsellor} softens their voice into a trapdoor. 'Leaving is allowed. Staying while empty is not heroic.'

Lines.Speaker: system
Lines.Text: SANITY THRESHOLD BREACHED. Recommended action: withdraw from competitive track.

Lines.Speaker: @ally
Lines.Text: {ally} does not argue. They just say, 'I will walk you to the gate. No speeches.'

Lines.Speaker: @homeroom
Lines.Text: We can mark you incomplete. Incomplete is still a kind of answer.

Lines.Speaker: @head
Lines.Text: Ninety-nine percent includes the ones who leave before the machine finishes chewing.

Text: You think in exits. The System called it failure; you call it refusing to let a school reformat your skull.

Choices.Text: Walk out mid-ceremony. Let the mic feed on silence.
Sign the withdrawal form with a hand that finally stops shaking.

Lines.Speaker: narrator
Lines.Text: Confetti falls from a ceiling that did not approve confetti. Someone replaced the school hymn with a circus march.

Lines.Speaker: @gremlin
Lines.Text: {gremlin} rides a stolen podium like a parade float. 'Year One: the musical! Bad reviews welcome!'

Lines.Speaker: @proctor
Lines.Text: {proctor} tries to restore order and somehow judges a pie-throwing contest instead.

Lines.Speaker: @president
Lines.Text: {president}'s speech dissolves into laughter they cannot stop. Authority has a rubber nose now.

Lines.Speaker: @rival
Lines.Text: {rival} wipes cream from their cheek. 'You turned prestige into slapstick. I hate that it works.'

Lines.Speaker: system
Lines.Text: ERROR: Ceremony tone = CARNIVAL. Recalibrating dignity... failed.

Lines.Speaker: @head
Lines.Text: If the school becomes a circus, the ringmaster is still a kind of number one. Do not celebrate yet.

Lines.Speaker: narrator
Lines.Text: The accent color on the monochrome banners is pie filling. History will not know how to cite this.

Text: You think in punchlines that break systems—absurdity as strategy, laughter as a crowbar.

Choices.Text: Take a bow. Demand an encore exam made of riddles and custard.
Crown {gremlin} co-jester. Split the chaos like a shared dessert.

Lines.Speaker: narrator
Lines.Text: The top rank lights up—and it is not your name. The hall gasps at a coronation you staged from the wings.

Lines.Speaker: @ally
Lines.Text: {ally} freezes as the number one seal lands on them. 'You... gave this to me. On purpose.'

Lines.Speaker: @rival
Lines.Text: {rival}'s jaw tightens. 'So the throne was never the point. The sculptor was.'

Lines.Speaker: @ex1
Lines.Text: {ex1} nods like a fallen monarch recognizing a better game. 'Kingmakers outlive kings. Remember that.'

Lines.Speaker: @president
Lines.Text: {president} reads the results twice. 'Unusual. Effective. Politically radioactive.'

Lines.Speaker: @homeroom
Lines.Text: Your stats did not peak. Your loyalty did. The System hates variables it did not invent.

Lines.Speaker: system
Lines.Text: NOTE: Primary asset elevated via secondary actor. Monitor both.

Text: You think in other people—power as a gift with teeth, victory measured by who stands where you place them.

Choices.Text: Bow to {ally}. Mean it. Keep the strings soft.
Whisper the cost: crowns attract knives; you will catch them first.

Lines.Speaker: narrator
Lines.Text: The hall screens flicker. For one impossible second, the System UI speaks in your cadence—pauses included.

Lines.Speaker: system
Lines.Text: LEARNING COMPLETE. Student uniqueness exceeded training set. New evaluator template: YOU.

Lines.Speaker: @head
Lines.Text: We built a machine to standardize excellence. It has started wearing your face.

Lines.Speaker: @broker
Lines.Text: {broker} goes pale. 'If the app thinks like you, every secret just got a roommate.'

Lines.Speaker: @rival
Lines.Text: {rival} stares at the feed. 'Congratulations. You became the exam.'

Lines.Speaker: @gremlin
Lines.Text: {gremlin} waves at the camera. 'Hi, Future Tyrant Software!' The camera waves back. That is new.

Lines.Speaker: @homeroom
Lines.Text: Year Two will not test you. It will test everyone else against the shape of your decisions.

Text: You think so strangely the school learned you by heart—and now the mirror wants a body.

Choices.Text: Accept the merge. Become the quiet voice behind every quest.
Fracture the template. Leave the System with your worst habits only.

Lines.Speaker: narrator
Lines.Text: You reach for help that is not there. The hall has become a jury with popcorn.

Lines.Speaker: @ally
Lines.Text: {ally} does not look at you. 'You spent the year sharpening knives on people who carried you. Sit with that.'

Lines.Speaker: @rival
Lines.Text: {rival} laughs once. 'Even I don't partner with a sinkhole. Find another mark.'

Lines.Speaker: @gremlin
Lines.Text: {gremlin} boos with jazz hands. 'Dead end! Try again from orientation, traitor!'

Lines.Speaker: @president
Lines.Text: {president} seals a form. 'No study group will claim you. The gate is that way. So is the restart.'

Lines.Speaker: @homeroom
Lines.Text: You optimized betrayal until the campus ran out of fools. That is not strategy. That is a loop.

Lines.Speaker: system
Lines.Text: SOFTLOCK: Social capital depleted. Quest chain unsolvable. Restart recommended.

Lines.Speaker: narrator
Lines.Text: Somewhere beyond the banners, the gate waits like a punchline you earned.

Text: You thought like a razor with no handle—cut everyone, including the future that needed allies. The school laughs you back to zero.

Choices.Text: Eat the mockery. Restart from the gate with empty pockets.
